acceptance_predicates.description: ASB exposes an additive v1.15 ControlServer provider-catalog route with capability negotiation and typed older-server/unavailable outcomes.
The route publishes every eligible AR-1719 explicit :free and free-router model with normalized metadata, capabilities, provider profile, generation, and digest intact.
Provider-profile, generation, digest, mode, stale, unknown, unavailable, and model-mismatch failures are rejected before provider calls or state mutation.
Human and --json diagnostics are stable, actionable, and contain no credentials or raw provider payloads.
Explicit live requests never silently fall back to static catalog, mock provider, or offline replay; development auth/signature/key warnings remain non-blocking.
The exact ASB/TUI heads qualify the installed asb tui install followed by bare asb tui dynamic-catalog wizard journey.

definition_of_done: AR-1719 exact merged catalog evidence and TUI AR-1720 readiness are recorded.
Focused contract, catalog, mismatch, privacy, human/JSON, and paired journey tests pass.
Independent review and all required hosted checks pass on signed/DCO product and state changes.
